map.算法（Parkland）：24h 总量 = 4 × 体重(kg) × 烧伤面积: The algorithm (Parkland): 24-hour total = 4 x body weight(kg) x burn area TBSA(%) in mL; half in the first 8h and the other half in the last 16h; the amount due at a given moment = total x hours elapsed/...
map.烧伤复苏：成人烧伤后 24h 液体方案初拟: Burn resuscitation: an initial 24-hour fluid plan for adult burns
map.急救参考：现场/转运估补液量: Emergency reference: on-scene and transport fluid estimates
map.监测调整：按尿量等实时调速度: Monitoring and adjustment: change the rate in real time based on urine output and similar signs
map.伤后毛细血管渗漏最重在前 8h，半量快速补充恢复血容量；后 16h 渗漏减轻，匀: Capillary leakage after injury is heaviest in the first 8h, so half the volume is given quickly to restore circulating volume; in the last 16h leakage eases, so give the rest at a steady rate to avoid pulmonary edema
map.儿童/吸入伤怎么算？: How are children or inhalation injuries handled?
map.儿童用改良 Brooke 或按体重更精细公式，吸入性损伤常需更多；Parklan: For children use the modified Brooke formula or a more precise weight-based formula, since inhalation injury often needs more; Parkland is only an adult starting point and must be adjusted per the burn unit protocol and urine output (at least 0.5 mL/kg/h in adults).
